what_this_is: The Workshop row that keeps one shared checkout of the Workshop on origin/main every five minutes, at the Mac that holds it, without losing anyone's work. The checkout is granted as the use-git-in-a-folder folder (the switch input names it under computer.use-git-in-a-folder); the pass is do-work/keep-the-shared-checkout-current.mjs, the same file the tests run.

payload.label: Keep the shared Workshop checkout on origin/main
payload.job: Every five minutes, bring the shared Workshop checkout on this computer up to origin/main, keeping every file someone is changing, every untracked file, and every commit not on origin, and saving the whole working state on a local rescue ref first.
payload.description: One pass over the granted checkout (--root). It refuses, touching nothing, when the checkout is not on branch main, when .git/index.lock exists, when a merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert is in progress, or when git fetch fails. Otherwise it saves the whole working state (tracked changes, untracked files, and commits not on origin/main) as a local refs/rescue/workshop-shared-<time> commit that is never pushed, then keeps every path whose bytes differ from both HEAD and origin, and every path changed in the last 120 seconds, skips the clean ones changed in the last 120 seconds until the next pass, moves HEAD and the index to origin/main with git reset --mixed, writes origin's bytes over the clean paths, and names the files origin deleted (with a removal proof) for disk-guard's removal list. It never deletes a file and never runs git reset --hard, git clean or git push. Returns outcome (ran, refused or stopped), behind_before and behind_after, the rescue_ref, local_commits, updated, removal_entries, kept and skipped (each with why).

provenance.source: Written for the Workshop: keeps the shared checkout current by a scheduled pass, replacing a hand-run reset that lost no work but could not run unattended
